```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node")
    
    # Build lookup
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track which nodes are still retained
    retained = {n["id"] for n in nodes}
    removed_order = []
    
    # Process nodes deeper first, tie-break by node ID
    # Sort by (-depth, id)
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Check if node has retained children
        has_retained_children = any(c in retained for c in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Check if removing this node still leaves all required symbols represented
        # Simulate removal
        retained.discard(nid)
        symbols_present = {node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained}
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_present):
            # Removal is valid
            removed_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Cannot remove, restore
            retained.add(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```

```python
    initial_symbols = {n["symbol"] for n in nodes}

        else:
            # Cannot remove, restore
            retained.add(nid)
    
    return {
```
